edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the source of the ERC20 transfer call.
msg.sender reaches _transfer and is tested against the sniper blacklist.
initContract is owner-gated and owner is derived from msg.sender.
initDefaultLists is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
openTrading is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
wreckSniper is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
revertAccidentalERC20Tx is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setMultisigAddress is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setExcludeFromFee is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
manualSwap is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
manualSend is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
launchTime is assigned directly from block.timestamp.
openTrading reads block.timestamp to record launch time.
swapTokensForEth uses block.timestamp as the router deadline.
_taxFee feeds the fee computation inside _getValues.
_teamDev feeds the dev fee computation inside _getValues.
_getValues calls _getTValues which performs mul/div fee math.
_getValues calls _getRValues to convert t amounts to r amounts.
_taxFee is multiplied and divided to derive the token fee.
_teamDev is multiplied and divided to derive the dev fee.
_rOwned balances are read and written during transfers.
_tOwned balances participate in the excluded-account transfer paths.
inSwap guards the auto-swap block inside _transfer against nested execution.
_transfer dispatches into _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer selects the standard transfer path.
_tokenTransfer selects the transfer-to-excluded path.
_tokenTransfer selects the transfer-from-excluded path.
_tokenTransfer selects the both-excluded transfer path.
_tokenTransfer temporarily removes fees when takeFee is false.
_tokenTransfer restores fees after a fee-free transfer.
_transfer triggers the auto-liquify swap to ETH before updating balances.
_transfer sends ETH to the team dev address after the swap.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
sendETHToTeamDev performs the native ETH transfer.
revertAccidentalERC20Tx performs an arbitrary external token call.
The router swap can call back into the token (pair callbacks) re-entering _transfer state updates.
A malicious token/pair callback could re-enter _tokenTransfer during an in-flight swap.
_reflectFee subtracts the fee from _rTotal using SafeMath.
_reflectFee adds the fee to _tFeeTotal.
_transferStandard subtracts/adds reflection balances that feed _getValues math.
_transferStandard invokes _reflectFee to burn reflections.
_transferToExcluded updates _tOwned balances with fee math.
_transferFromExcluded updates _tOwned balances with fee math.
_devF credits the dev reflection share to the contract balance.
_getCurrentSupply subtracts excluded balances from _rTotal.
_getRate derives the rate from _getCurrentSupply.
removeAllFee zeroes _taxFee after saving the previous value.
restoreAllFee reads back the previously saved tax fee.
_previousTaxFee is written back into _taxFee.
_previousTeamDev is written back into _teamDev on fee restore.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for WETH and the swap call.

swapEnabled gates the automatic swap inside _transfer.
tradingOpen gates public transfers inside _transfer.
_isExcluded selects the balance-accounting path in _tokenTransfer.
_isExcludedFromFee decides whether the transfer takes a fee.
_numOfTokensToExchangeForTeamDev is the swap threshold checked in _transfer.
_maxTxAmount limit value is referenced by the transfer gate.
_approve writes into the _allowances mapping.

deliver adds tAmount to _tFeeTotal.

wreckSniper zeroes and reassigns token balances.

openAntiBotFees writes _teamDev.

noFeeTrading zeroes _teamDev.

multisigOnlyTrading writes _teamDev.

normalization_plan.reason: sender is a parameter of _transfer used only to drive its internal transfer logic.
recipient is a parameter of _transfer consumed by blacklist checks and balance updates.
amount is a parameter of _transfer consumed by the transfer math.
takeFee is a parameter of _tokenTransfer controlling fee removal/restoration.
tAmount is the input of _transferStandard forwarded to _getValues.
tokenAmount is the parameter approved and swapped by swapTokensForEth.
account is the parameter blacklisted by RemoveSniper.
account is the parameter whose balances are drained by wreckSniper.
amount is the parameter halved and transferred by sendETHToTeamDev.
multiSigAddress is the parameter stored by setMultisigAddress.
contractTokenBalance is computed in _transfer and passed to swapTokensForEth.
overMinTokenBalance is the threshold flag gating the swapTokensForEth call.
path is the local swap route array used by swapTokensForEth.
currentRate is computed and consumed by _getValues for r-value conversion.
contractETHBalance is the local ETH amount forwarded to sendETHToTeamDev.
